_comment: Terrain. Every land province has a biome (its vegetation, from tools/data/vegetation_source.png) and a relief (from the heightmap); tools/generate_setup.py assigns them. Effects multiply (biome x relief) or add up. color: the Terrain map mode. feature: the old vegetation feature it gives the province (forest, steppe, desert, tundra), which buildings and the city view use. density: people the land feeds, relative to farmland (1). tribal: share of its people who live as tribesmen and herders rather than settled peasants. pasture: grazing for nomads (0..1). move: days on the march, times. defense: dice for those defending it (forests and mountains favour them). native: dice the people who live there get fighting on their own ground. mounted: strength of horses (and chariots, tanks) there, times. siege: strength of siege engines there, times. supply: regiments the land can feed before an army starves (biome), times (relief); people living there feed more. attrition: share of an army's men lost every month to hunger, cold, heat and sickness there. passable: false for land armies can't enter.

biomes.name: Ice and polar desert
biomes.description: Ice sheets and frozen rock: nothing grows.

biomes.name: Tundra
biomes.description: Treeless cold plains of moss and lichen, frozen most of the year: reindeer herders and hunters.

biomes.name: Taiga
biomes.description: The endless northern forest of pine, spruce and larch: long winters, few people.

biomes.name: Temperate forest
biomes.description: Oak, beech and elm woods with clearings of farmland: rich soil once the forest is cut.

biomes.name: Steppe
biomes.description: Open grassland from horizon to horizon: the home of horse herders, and of cavalry.

biomes.name: Mediterranean
biomes.description: Dry summers and mild wet winters: olives, vines and wheat, the farmland of the ancient world.

biomes.name: Subtropical forest
biomes.description: Warm evergreen and monsoon forests with farmed lowlands: rice and millet country.

biomes.name: Savanna
biomes.description: Tropical grassland with scattered trees, green in the rains and dry for months.

biomes.name: Dry steppe and scrub
biomes.description: Thorn bush, dry grass and scrub on the edges of the deserts: goats, camels and hardy herders.

biomes.name: Desert
biomes.description: Sand, gravel and bare rock under a merciless sun: only nomads cross it, from well to well.

biomes.name: Tropical rainforest
biomes.description: Dense, hot, wet jungle: armies crawl, fevers kill, and its peoples ambush from the trees.

biomes.name: Floodplain
biomes.description: A great river's valley in dry land, watered and enriched by its yearly flood: the most crowded farmland of the ancient world.

biomes.name: Oasis
biomes.description: Springs and palm groves in the middle of the desert: water, dates and a resting place for caravans.

reliefs.name: Hills
reliefs.description: Rolling and broken ground: slower going, and good ground to defend.

reliefs.name: Mountains
reliefs.description: Steep ranges and narrow passes: armies crawl, horses and engines are of little use, and a few can hold off many.

reliefs.name: Impassable peaks
reliefs.description: The roof of the world: the highest ranges and plateaus, where no army can march.
